title: SelfModelView
description: The 'current self' is NOT a store. It is a versioned interpretation: an ordered pointer set over immutable autobiographical primaries. Omnai is a projection. Revising the self-model = emitting a new version (append), never mutating primaries.

foregrounded.description: Ordered primary ids the self currently prioritizes. Selfhood lives here — in what is foregrounded now, not in what is stored.

backgrounded.description: Tombstoned/de-indexed primary ids still on the audit trail.

supersession_chain.description: The accountable-change lineage that produced this version.

integrity_ratio.description: accounted change / total change since prior version. Layer 3 computes and stamps; the view does not author it.
